findings.text: follow-on: the new absolute-green lint reads the wording, not the base, so it refuses a done-when whose named check is genuinely green. A done-when 'pytest tests/test_green_only.py exits 0' matches _ABSOLUTE_GREEN_GATE (node.py:141) and carries no _GREEN_BASE_REVISION/_DELTA_AGAINST_BASE phrase, so validate_node:1186 fails it although the file is green. Measured: tests/test_unreadable_names_its_word.py, named by one of the six census-refused rows (r-20260928T055726955192), is genuinely green on this checkout (3 passed), yet its done-when is refused. The section-15 row states the negative explicitly -- 'a node whose files are genuinely green must not be refused, so the check reads the base rather than the wording' -- and eacad644 replaced the base-reading test with a wording test, so this clause is unmet. Remedy: key the refusal on the done-when itself declaring a red base (the prior '\b(?:before|base)\b' condition), or accept a citation as disclosure rather than as a precondition for a green node.

follow-on: the citation the lint accepts is unverified, so the guard admits a false statement. tests/test_done_when_lints.py:190 admits 'pytest tests/test_preexisting.py exits 0; adds no failure to base' while the named file carries a failing test (assert 1 == 2), and _GREEN_BASE_REVISION matches any 7-40 hex characters after 'green at base' without checking the revision resolves or that the check was green there. The lint therefore passes wording that asserts a delta or a green base which is not true, the same escape it exists to close.

follow-on: the admitted spellings are narrow, so a legitimate delta worded outside them is refused. _DELTA_AGAINST_BASE (node.py:149) admits only 'adds/zero added/no added failures to|over|against base', and _ABSOLUTE_GREEN_GATE (node.py:141) still requires the literal token pytest and a tests/ path; 'no regressions versus base', 'same failures as base' or a green check spelled without the word pytest are refused. This is the over-refusal direction the plan's negative warns against (one false refusal teaches coordinators to stop running the check). The prior review's carried follow-on on _NUMERIC_AGREEMENT (gerund 'agreeing', unit 's') is untouched by these commits.

item_verdicts.done_when: the reviewed run's done_when names tests/test_done_when_lints.py's three cases plus the paired test_crew_node/test_crew_dryrun records; the manifest's baseline_suite records 3 failures (exactly the three new cases) and after_suite 24 passed, and the declared negative control at EXIT=1. Reproduced the head arm in the reviewed worktree: 24 passed, EXIT=0.
item_verdicts.goal: three dispatch done-when lints drawn from the section-15 census; validate_node refuses an independent reading without numeric agreement (:1164), absence evidence without a coverage floor and base count (:1170), and a named exit-zero check without a green-base revision or delta citation (:1186).
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it carries the four commits, changed_paths, flat baseline_suite/after_suite JSON with log_paths, the negative_control_log path, and measurement_cwd of the base scratch arm.

justifications.durability: tests/test_done_when_lints.py:183-239 now proves the uncited refusal, the delta admission, the flagged-pytest admission and that no repository test is executed (marker absent), and the negative control reddens the agreement clause; but the plan's negative case (a green uncited check admitted) is untested and in fact violated, and the accepted citation is unverified, so the guard's admission side is unguarded.
justifications.evidence: the manifest's paired gate reconciles with the two logs (3 failing ids at base, 24 passed at head) and I reproduced the head arm at cd6fa4e40 (24 passed, EXIT=0); the negative control is a real EXIT=1 on the agreement case. The census (1800/1800 rows at base and head, 6 absolute-green refusals, 2 broad-agreement false positives) is self-reported and was not re-run.
justifications.fit: the new patterns follow the module-level regex idiom of _EVIDENCE_SIGNALS and _GATE_POPULATION, the refusal uses the existing fail('demonstrable', ...) form, and the removed path drops its now-unused os/sys imports; no plan or ticket label is introduced. The _ABSOLUTE_GREEN_GATE regex is dense but consistent with the file, though untested against adversarial spacing.
justifications.goal_fidelity: all three lints are present and the red-base execution is gone, but the absolute-green lint now decides on wording rather than the base, refusing a genuinely green uncited check and accepting an unverified delta claim -- so it does not meet the section-15 row's stated negative.
justifications.scope_discipline: the increment is reckon/crew/node.py and tests/test_done_when_lints.py only, both inside the declared write paths, with no unrelated change.
